entries.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the attached actual game screenshot into a believable in-game HUD design proposal. Preserve the existing pixel-art gameplay scene, positions, hero, monsters and environment below the top HUD exactly as closely as possible. Remove the operating-system title bar and purple sharing control so only the game content fills a landscape 16:9 frame. Replace ONLY the existing SEAN health/lives region in the upper-right header with the described compact designed interface, occupying roughly the same header area and never hanging into gameplay. Keep KILLS 0 legible at far right, and current left header information unchanged. This is an in-game-scale mockup, NOT a zoomed product board, no additional inset or concept labels. All concepts show the SAME state: Sean, HP4 of5 (exactly FIVE discrete HP indicators, first FOUR mint/green active and FIFTH clearly dark/broken), and exactly THREE remaining lives shown by THREE small recognizable Sean heads/photos in a separate row. Sean is bald with short gray goatee, orange shirt and blue overalls, normal costume. Clearly label rows HP and LIVES; use only SEAN, HP, LIVES on the new component. Concept design: A battered horizontal company employee ID badge, clipped into the upper-right HUD. Cream laminated card in tarnished brass holder, small stamped SEAN name, subtle barcode, large five safety lamps in a single HP row. Beneath, three clipped employee photo tabs representing lives. Practical worksite identity badge, clearly card-like with rounded corners and metal clip.
